title: Add a task from the Today screen
description: As a user, I want to type a task into the quick-add field on the Today screen and add it, so that it shows up in my task list without needing to sign in.
note: No sign-in required for this flow — sign-in (Google/Apple/email via Firebase) is a separate optional modal and must not be exercised by automated tests, since it involves real account credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Today screen is shown, when I type a task title into the quick-add input, then an 'Add task' button and a timer stepper appear.
When I tap 'Add task' with a non-empty title, then the input clears and the new task appears in the task list below.
When I type a task title containing a natural-language date/time (e.g. 'tomorrow at 5pm'), then a parsed date is shown above the Add task button before I submit.
When the quick-add input is empty, then no 'Add task' button is shown.

quick_add_input.note: placeholder text is passed as a prop; look for the empty text input on the Today screen
